newsitem.title: UK: Robert Lowe unveils takeovers, plans issue.
newsitem.headline: Robert Lowe unveils takeovers, plans issue.

text.p: British sports and leisurewear distributor and manufacturer Robert Lowe Plc said on Monday it planned to buy Westfield Medical Ltd and Elms Marketing Ltd for 6.47 million pounds and 6.2 million respectively.
Robert Lowe said in a statement it had also acquired Flock Print, a garment decorator for sports replica products, for up to 1.1 million pounds.
The company said it also planned to issue up to 28,005,459 shares at 25p each to raise seven million pounds.

Robert Lowe said Westfield Medical was the largest privately owned British producer of sterilisable packaging for the medical and healthcare industries. Elms Marketing distributes sports and leisurewear.
